summary: Whole-subject input references such as ${input.vrs-review} accept the same input names as mission input declarations, including hyphenated names. Invalid input names remain rejected.

replay.detail: No stored event or replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No database, wire or checkpoint schema changes.

rules.detail: No fleet coordination or checkpoint rule version changes.

compatibility.detail: Declaration validation now accepts whole-subject input references using every valid mission input name, rather than a narrower variable-name grammar. Existing valid whole-subject and composite references remain supported. Older binaries still reject whole-subject references with hyphenated input names.

manual.detail: No migration or manual action is needed.

recovery.detail: Before reverting to an older binary, avoid whole-subject input references with names that its narrower grammar rejects.
